evidence_class: posthoc pilot-plus-geometry descriptive diagnostic; no new heldout occurrence endpoint
question: Among ultrarare species with the same nominal number of occupied pilot sources, how unequal or complementary are the sources' graph-weighted contributions to the remaining island source-access surface?

operator_semantics.important_correction: graph paths may traverse occupied or unoccupied islands; this is not an occupied-source stepping-stone chain
operator_semantics.source_pressure_mass: for source s, sum over all 4,126 heldout geometry targets of exp(-d_graph(target,s)/lambda_bioregion), with unreachable targets contributing zero
operator_semantics.source_share: source_pressure_mass divided by the sum across the focal species' occupied pilot sources
operator_semantics.interpretation: number of equally influential sources that would yield the same concentration of graph-pressure leverage
operator_semantics.source_removal_graph_empty: target changes from at least one graph-reachable source to zero graph-reachable sources after deletion of one pilot source

preserves: exact count of occupied sources in each bioregion
matched_random_placement_null.sampling_frame: pilot islands in the corresponding bioregion, without replacement within replicate
matched_random_placement_null.primary_descriptive_contrast: actual effective source count minus species-specific mean matched-null effective source count

guardrails: do not interpret graph paths as realized dispersal routes
do not call pilot occupied sources the last remaining global populations
do not infer demographic rescue, persistence, recolonization or extinction risk
do not use this posthoc diagnostic to rescue or upgrade the v1.119 heldout evidence hierarchy
do not select a new occupancy threshold from this diagnostic
do not open or use heldout occurrence values
manuscript_role: mechanistic clarification of why source count and source arrangement are distinct; any management claim remains a hypothesis requiring independent dynamic or response-sealed validation
